echo.text: This data product loads deals from the CRM deals API, continuing through every page (including after a token refresh or rate-limit retry). A deal is current only when its status is present and is neither the literal value deleted nor the literal value unknown; a deleted status, a missing/empty status, and the literal unknown value are all excluded, never defaulted to current. Any other present status value is treated as current -- the operator was asked twice to confirm whether deleted/unknown/absent are the complete non-current set, or to supply a specific positive active value instead, and did not confirm either, so this is a disclosed assumption rather than a source-confirmed enumeration. status is landed as an internal-only column on the deals relation (used solely to verify this filtering independently of the transform's own logic) alongside the governed deal_id, stage, amount, and updated_at columns; status carries no semantic role so it never reaches describe_models, a governed query, or the stated Output, though it remains visible to direct access against the physical table. Owner name and owner email are dropped at ingestion and never land in any stored or served surface, including any raw/internal relation. No priority or attention ranking is computed, since none was requested. The term 'Current deal' distinguishes deleted, missing/unknown, and current status outcomes with the same disclosed assumption, and uses the platform-default P3 priority since no priority was stated in the document. The term 'Redacted field' defines a field dropped entirely from every landed and served relation, and also uses the platform-default P3 priority since no priority was stated. amount is landed as an exact decimal value, sized 18 digits total with 6 after the decimal point (an agent-chosen ceiling, since the source did not state one), with no floating-point truncation and no silent rounding: the transform validates every landed value reproduces the source's own digits within that bound and raises rather than silently rounding if a value ever needs more precision. The 'Current deals' output promises that every row is a current deal, that owner name and email never appear in this output or any other stored surface, and that no ranking or attention-score field is ever produced. Four decisions are recorded: the current-deal definition rests on the source status field with the disclosed deleted/unknown/absent assumption, landed internal-only as a verification witness; owner and email are redacted at ingestion; no attention ranking is computed because no threshold was supplied; and amount is landed at exact 18/6 decimal precision, validated rather than silently rounded.

decisions.ruling: Use the source status field to distinguish current deals from deleted deals: a deal is current only when status is present and is neither the literal value deleted nor the literal value unknown. A deal whose status is the deleted tombstone is excluded, and a deal whose status is missing, empty, or exactly unknown is also excluded -- never defaulted to current. The operator was asked twice whether deleted/unknown/absent are the complete set of non-current values, or whether a specific positive active value should be matched instead, and did not confirm either; this ruling proceeds on the disclosed assumption that any other present status value is current, pending correction. status itself is landed only as an internal-only column on the deals relation, used solely to verify this filtering independently of the transform's own logic.
Owner name and owner email are dropped at ingestion and never land in any stored surface of this product, raw or served.
This product does not compute, land, or expose a priority or attention ranking of deals, because no ranking threshold was supplied.

Land amount as an exact decimal value, sized to 18 total digits with 6 digits after the decimal point, per the operator's explicit instruction that amount must preserve the source value without floating-point truncation or silent rounding. The 18/6 bound was not stated by the source; it is the agent's chosen ceiling. The transform validates every landed value reproduces the source's own digits exactly within that bound and raises rather than silently rounding if a source value ever needs more than 6 digits after the decimal point.

proposal.intent: Provide a governed, queryable view of the current CRM sales pipeline for sales-ops and revenue-analyst review. The product exposes active deal records (identifier, stage, amount, last-updated time) while keeping account-owner identity details out of every stored and served surface.

questions.question: What deals are currently active in the CRM pipeline, and what stage, amount, and last-updated time does each have?
What is the count and total amount of active deals, broken down by stage?

proposal.scope: Include only current deals from the CRM deals source: records whose source status field is present and is not the literal value deleted or the literal value unknown. Exclude deleted deals, and exclude deals whose status is missing, empty, or exactly unknown, from every governed relation this product serves -- an absent status, and the literal unknown value, are never treated as current by default. No other status value was confirmed as a further exclusion despite being asked twice, so any status value other than deleted, unknown, or absent/empty is treated as current; this is a disclosed assumption, not a source-confirmed enumeration of every active value. Retrieve every deal across every page the source reports, continuing after a token refresh or a rate-limit retry rather than stopping early. Exclude owner name and owner email from every stored and served surface, including any raw/internal landed relation, not only the final output; these fields are dropped at ingestion rather than masked. Do not compute, land, or expose a priority/attention ranking or score for deals, because no ranking threshold was supplied.

terms.definition: A deal whose source status field is present and is neither the literal value deleted nor the literal value unknown. Three status outcomes are distinguished: deleted (excluded, the tombstone), missing/empty or exactly unknown (excluded, never treated as current by default), and any other present value (current). The set of values a present, non-deleted, non-unknown status can actually take was not confirmed by the source despite being asked twice, so this term treats every such value as current rather than requiring a positive enumeration; that gap is disclosed here rather than silently assumed away. "Current" here is a status classification, not a time-window calculation, so it needs no clock anchor.
terms.name: Current deal

terms.definition: A field that is removed from all landed and served relations of this product, rather than masked, truncated, or replaced with placeholder text. Owner name and owner email are the redacted fields for this product.
